From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Quick question before a demo — GitHub app perms and OSS usage

Hey Devon — great to see you in the product, and thanks for the questions.

Short answers up front:
- The GitHub integration supports both org installations and repo-scoped installs. A repo admin can install with limited scope; org admin only required for org-wide installs.
- By default, we do not retain repository source beyond the processing session unless you opt in to longer-term indexing. For private repos, we support customer-managed encryption keys and strict audit logging (SOC2-ready controls).

Would you like a 30-minute walkthrough? Here are a few windows I have this week (PST):
- Tue 6/28 11:00–11:30
- Tue 6/28 13:30–14:00
- Wed 6/29 10:00–10:30

Or book directly: https://calendly.com/redwood-ben/30min

—Ben
